# Agent Web Crawler MVP (Fetching + Extraction + Cleaning + Reranking)

## This is still an AI-driven programming module, with the ultimate goal of being able to crawl and automatically parse almost all HTML web pages, and perform data cleaning on the text within the web pages for use by the Agent.

---

## The following content was generated by AI.

This is a extensible web module skeleton for an Agent:
- Async HTTP fetching with retry/backoff, per-host rate limit, and a simple disk cache (ETag/Last-Modified aware)
- HTML extraction (main text + title + links)
- Cleaning + chunking
- Simple reranking (BM25-ish + light structural boosts)

## Structure

- `webkit.fetchers.http` — `HttpFetcher`, `HostLimiter`, `DiskCache`
- `webkit.extractors.html` — `HtmlExtractor`
- `webkit.pipeline.clean` — `Cleaner`
- `webkit.pipeline.rerank` — `SimpleReranker`
- `webkit.spiders.base` — `Spider`
- `webkit.spiders.wiki` — `WikiSpider` (example adapter)
